news.title: Asian Stocks Rally & Huang’s Return Revives AI Trade – Asia Market Wrap
news.description: Asian stocks surged the most since July as Huang’s return to lead Nvidia revived confidence in the AI trade, triggering a rebound in the region’s major chipmakers following last week’s selloff. The MSCI Asia Pacific Index climbed 3.8%, snapping an eight-day losing streak that had pushed the benchmark close to bear market territory.
